mentions.name: Universymbols
mentions.description: A tool that restyles icons to match an app's icon set, such as SF Symbols, Material Symbols, and many more. It works through a pipeline of several AI models, including Nano Banana and OpenAI's gpt-image-1, for the raw image generation.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on Universymbols, which lets you restyle icons to match your app’s icon set, like SF Symbols, Material Symbols, and many more.
